sharedReferenceIds.why: C-Media's vendor ID with a product ID more than one maker's units ship: the kernel gives it a DSD quirk under one maker's name (Linux kernel sound/usb/quirks.c, v6.12), and another maker's firmware note names it too (the review of PR #1402, 2026-11-04); a profile on it waits for a captured product string

the Amanero Combo384, a USB interface board DACs of several makers are built on: the kernel's DSD quirk for this ID follows the board's firmware, its bcdDevice, alone (Linux kernel sound/usb/quirks.c, v6.12)

the WaveIO, a USB interface board other makers' DACs are built on, as its maker describes it (the review of PR #1402, 2026-11-04); the kernel gives the board's altsetting 3 a DSD quirk (Linux kernel sound/usb/quirks.c, v6.12); a profile on it waits for a captured product string
XMOS's reference product ID, which the owner identified as shared: an iFi unit carries it, with the product string iFi (by AMR) HD USB Audio (owner capture, Linux, 2026-11-04)
